Lightfoot Farm Market is a family-owned farm market and community gathering place dedicated to connecting people with local agriculture, small businesses, and the rural way of life. Located on a scenic farm in Millington, Tennessee, the market features farm-fresh produce, locally raised meats, eggs, baked goods, handmade goods, home décor, and products from more than 100 local vendors throughout the season. In addition to shopping, Lightfoot Farm Market hosts monthly events on the farm that bring families and the community together through food, entertainment, educational experiences, and opportunities to support local farmers, makers, and entrepreneurs in a welcoming outdoor setting.
